purpose: Teach: 断ら/就い/傘下/綿密/総論/凝らし/辛抱/リストアップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、無理な依頼は断られても引かなかった
lines.en: Your father, back in his younger days, never backed down — even when his boldest requests were refused.
lines.style: Slow reminiscing warmth, a distant gaze in the voice, gentle firm emphasis on 'never backed down'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社長に就いた日の事を語って下さった
lines.en: Yes. He once told me himself about the day he took up the presidency.
lines.style: Firm quiet 'yes', then measured filial pride, steady voice softened by the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、傘下企業との関係を大事にされた
lines.en: Even young, he treated the subsidiary companies under him with real care.
lines.style: Unhurried appreciative recollection, warm low register, a slight wistful fade on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営方針を綿密に練られた
lines.en: Yes. He would work the management strategy over meticulously, down to the last detail.
lines.style: Composed and deliberate, echoing the older man's cadence, quiet admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、講演の総論部分を覚えて下さった
lines.en: When he was young, he would commit the whole opening overview of his lectures to memory.
lines.style: Soft chuckle of remembrance at the start, slow savoring pace, fond emphasis on the feat.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員旅行に工夫を凝らして企画された
lines.en: Yes. Even the company trips — he planned those with such inventive little touches.
lines.style: Warming further, a small smile in the voice, lighter quicker pace on the fond detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、苦しい時にも辛抱されたお陰で成功された
lines.en: It was his perseverance through the hardest years, back then, that made his success.
lines.style: Grave gentle weight, a long pause before 'perseverance', delivered like a lesson worth keeping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新規取引候補をリストアップされた
lines.en: Yes. He drew up the lists of prospective new clients himself, every one.
lines.style: Quiet concluding reverence, a slow nod in the rhythm, voice lowering to close the memory.
